de1.P4.C3.ghi_chu: Anh doc duoc: 5 hoa do (image8), 3 hoa vang (image9), chon 4 bong (image10), bien co ve 'dung 1 bong do' (image11). Vay y a: cac cach chon 4 bong la (1 do, 3 vang); (2 do, 2 vang); (3 do, 1 vang); (4 do, 0 vang) - cac phuong an luu chi liet ke truong hop chon 3 bong. Y b dung: P(A) = C(5,1) . C(3,3) / C(8,4) = 1/14; P(B) = 1 (chi co 3 hoa vang nen chon 4 bong chac chan co it nhat 1 do) - mau luu (0,5; 0,75) sai. Can thay doi chieu de goc.

de1.P4.C6.ghi_chu: Toan bo ky hieu (ten tam giac, doan thang, goc) deu nam trong anh, khong doi chieu duoc. Rieng y b nhu dang luu da vo ly: khung viet 'Vi AB // AK' trong khi A la dinh chung - co the ky hieu doan thang da bi OCR sai. Y c (AH = h^2 / a, BH = a sin alpha) cung chua xac dinh duoc cac doan AH, BH, a, alpha ung voi anh nao. Can de goc/anh goc.
